svg.aria-label: Liangebra's diary: the last year as a heart of 370 tiny hearts, one per day; 511 contributions, longest streak 5 days, 3 followers, 9 stars. Top languages as nail polish: JavaScript 31%, Python 27%, HTML 15%, Lean 11%, Kotlin 8%. Paw prints signed by Marshmallow.
